# kyoto

> Make a slow Android TV or Google TV fast again over adb, without root: measure memory pressure, disable unused packages in small verified and reversible batches, tune settings, and optionally replace the stock launcher with a lightweight one (Kyoto Home). Bun + TypeScript CLI; Android launcher in Java.

AI agents helping someone with their TV: follow AGENTS.md step by step. Never run `--apply` yourself; the CLI exits with code 3 and prints the command to hand to the person holding the remote.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): playbook for AI coding agents (rules, steps, exit codes, troubleshooting)
- [docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md): full human walkthrough
- [docs/REFERENCE.md](docs/REFERENCE.md): commands, file formats, guard rules, measurement protocol
- [docs/case-study/hisense-huangshan/README.md](docs/case-study/hisense-huangshan/README.md): the reference TV, with data

## Data

- [catalog/packages.json](catalog/packages.json): known packages, what they are, risk of disabling
- [profiles/](profiles/): per-TV-model decisions (profile.json, packages.json, tune.json)

## Code

- [cli/main.ts](cli/main.ts): command dispatch
- [cli/batch.ts](cli/batch.ts): guard → snapshot → apply → verify → confirm → commit/revert
- [cli/guard.ts](cli/guard.ts): lifeline and protected package rules
- [cli/profile.ts](cli/profile.ts): profiles, catalog, suggest, mark
- [launcher/](launcher/): Kyoto Home
